gate_type: IMPLEMENTATION gate — Generic Gateway / Workstation Observation Binding (G20)
objective: Implement the smallest generic gateway/workstation observation binding mechanism: one or more simulation scopes publish observations through one logical gateway/workstation without coupling domain runtime to MES/API transport. Runtime remains sole source of truth; gateway is read-only observer/adapter/forwarding boundary; explicit deterministic scope->gateway binding; N scopes -> 1 gateway supported; 1 scope -> N gateways architecturally allowed (no one-gateway-per-scope invariant); gateway identity distinct from Workspace/Scope and PIM identity; message provenance preserved (workspace/scope/domain/run/time); semantic messages independently identifiable/idempotent; batching is transport-only; fail closed on unknown scope/duplicate/ambiguous binding/identity mismatch; deterministic serialization; gateway topology is not execution order or containment hierarchy. Reuse ObservationService/Router/Projection/ObservationGatewayProtocol/ASSY MES bridge seams. Additive generic model/binding/fixture + tests only.
explicit_non_objectives: No gateway as simulation engine or plant-truth owner
No gateway mandatory in containment hierarchy
forbidden_actions: Make gateway a simulation engine or plant-truth owner
Make gateway mandatory in containment hierarchy
stop_conditions: The binding seam requires a major incompatible redesign of existing observation/gateway architecture
The binding seam requires a new product decision not covered by the issue

acceptance_criteria.description: Multiple scopes bind to one gateway (N->1)
One scope may bind to multiple distinct gateways (1->N allowed)
Scope/runtime truth unchanged by gateway observation
Messages preserve source scope identity + independent/idempotent message identity
Duplicate/invalid/ambiguous binding + identity mismatch fail closed
Deterministic serialization independent of declaration order
Gateway identity does not impersonate PIM/Scope identity
Gateway topology is not execution order or containment hierarchy
ASSY MES bridge + G19/G18/G14/G15 + canonical baseline + full suite green
Working tree clean and branch/head pushed
